content.text:
The site matches the approved baselines again at both desktop and phone size. The visual tests now pass 2 of 2. I didn't approve any baselines or commit anything.

Two values in `site/css/styles.css` had been changed from Bootstrap's defaults:

- **`.small` font size:** it was `0.438em`, about half the intended `0.875em`. This made the "SKU: BST-498" line tiny and shifted the hero content up (5px on desktop, 10px on phone).
- **`.dropdown-toggle::after` margin:** it was `0.383em` instead of `0.255em`. This pushed the caret next to "Shop" in the navbar a couple of pixels to the right.

I found the second one by looking at the diff after the first fix. It was a small 10×4 px region around the caret.
